title: mesh-bus-ingress-socks5
description: Config for a SOCKS5 ingress listener. Constructed by mesh-bus-runtime from IngressCfg::Socks5.

listen.description: host:port to bind the SOCKS5 listener (0 for ephemeral port).

client_eof_semantics.description: After client write EOF, ingress calls StreamSendHalf::shutdown_write and keeps reading upstream returns until FIN.

connect_semantics.description: SOCKS5 CONNECT opens a StreamSession first and only replies Succeeded after the upstream open result is visible; post-open bytes try Linux TCP splice when the session exposes it, otherwise use split send/recv halves.

udp_associate_semantics.description: SOCKS5 UDP ASSOCIATE opens the relay; target-bearing relay packets are adapted through DatagramSession with PacketDedup return semantics.

pipeline_udp_decision_scope.description: When PipelineRuntime is attached, the forward pipeline evaluates UDP relay packets, not the UDP ASSOCIATE control request, because only relay packets carry the target.

udp_peer_binding.description: UDP ASSOCIATE accepts relay packets only from the UDP peer declared by the control request.

udp_session_affinity.description: Within one UDP ASSOCIATE control connection, datagrams for the same target reuse one bus session and flow_id.

udp_async_pump_status.description: High-throughput asynchronous UDP response pumping is active: per-target BusDatagramSendHalf held in UdpAssocTargetState; spawned recv pump task holds BusDatagramRecvHalf and encodes SOCKS5 UDP relay frames back to the client socket without blocking the forward send path.

bind_semantics.description: SOCKS5 BIND is a client-facing local-relay command, not a bus egress session: the adapter opens a local TCP listener, sends the listener endpoint as the first RFC1928 reply, accepts exactly one inbound peer (v1 single-accept), sends the accepted peer endpoint as the second reply, then bidirectionally copies bytes between the SOCKS5 control TCP and the accepted peer TCP. No BusSessionRequest is opened; BIND is policy/pipeline gated for Allow/Deny/Drop/Fail only. Wrong-peer rejection is IP-only; accept timeout reuses handshake_timeout and replies REP 0x06 TtlExpired.

auth_methods.description: Auth methods the live ingress will negotiate. NoAuth when no AuthConfig is set; UserPass (RFC1929) when an AuthConfig is set. GSSAPI is never negotiated.

gssapi_gate.description: GSSAPI (SOCKS5 method 0x01) is codec-recognized but never negotiated by this adapter. It is gated behind the default-off `gssapi` cargo feature and has no authenticator backend in any shipped build (GSSAPI_SUPPORTED reflects the build feature). A client whose greeting offers only GSSAPI receives the RFC1928 0x05 0xff no-acceptable-methods reply and the connection closes; a greeting that also offers a supported method negotiates that method normally. This is the documented full-RFC posture: full except an explicit, reserved, feature-gated GSSAPI capability.
